boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission campus activities and spaces with directly documented free access.

cards.title: Browse the University Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Building, Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit during an announced open period, then use the exhibition labels as prompts for a low-key conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Art Museum lists free admission.
cards.source_title: The University Art Museum Presents Noel W Anderson: Black Excellence
cards.access_notes: Check the museum visit page for current exhibition dates and hours; its current page notes a summer closure.

cards.entity_name: University Art Museum Collections Study Space
cards.title: Explore the Collections Study Space
cards.subtitle: University Art Museum, Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Check the selected holdings, compare one work with a friend, or contact the museum ahead if you want a guided visit.
cards.short_summary: A public viewing and study gallery for university art.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany states that the Collections Study Space is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: University at Albany Fine Art Collections
cards.access_notes: Email the museum to view selected holdings, schedule a guided tour, conduct research, or reserve classroom time.

cards.title: Browse the UAlbany Free Market
cards.subtitle: The Bean, Campus Center
cards.notes: Stop by during the listed Monday or Friday window to browse clothing, household items, and décor without buying anything.
cards.short_summary: A campus swap-style market with free items.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany says students can shop the Free Market for clothes, household items, and décor for free.
cards.access_notes: The Spring 2026 listing gives hours as Mondays and Fridays, noon–4 p.m.; confirm current scheduling before going.

cards.title: Take a CDPHP Cycle! ride
cards.subtitle: UAlbany campus hubs
cards.notes: Use the campus bike-share instructions to locate a hub, then take a daylight ride with a friend on a route you both know.
cards.short_summary: Bike-share access for current UAlbany affiliates.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany states that current students, faculty, and staff have free access to CDPHP Cycle! bikes.
cards.access_notes: Available to current students, faculty, and staff; use the university's parking and transit page for instructions and campus hubs.

cards.title: Walk the Purple Path
cards.subtitle: Exterior of UAlbany’s Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Pick a comfortable loop, walk side by side, and pause at a campus landmark instead of treating it like a workout deadline.
cards.short_summary: A named multi-modal path around campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany describes the Purple Path as a multi-modal path around the exterior of campus and lists it among walking, running, and biking routes.
cards.access_notes: Available year-round, weather permitting; paths are multi-use and not regularly patrolled, so use awareness and normal path etiquette.

cards.title: Shoot around at the outdoor courts
cards.subtitle: Behind Dutch Quad, Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Bring a ball if you have one, agree on a short game or shooting challenge, and share the court with other users.
cards.short_summary: Public outdoor basketball courts on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists outdoor basketball courts behind Dutch Quad and says anyone can access its outdoor courts and fields.
cards.access_notes: The university says students, staff, and Capital Region community members can access outdoor courts and fields; community parking is available.

cards.title: Rally at the non-varsity tennis courts
cards.subtitle: Behind Dutch Quad, Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Bring racquets and balls, keep the session casual, and rotate off if others are waiting for an open court.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor tennis courts open to campus and community users.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists non-varsity tennis courts behind Dutch Quad and says anyone can access its outdoor courts and fields.
cards.access_notes: The university says students, staff, and Capital Region community members can access outdoor courts and fields; community parking is available.

cards.title: Set up a casual soccer run
cards.subtitle: Behind Dutch Quad, Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Bring a ball, keep teams small, and choose a shared end time so the field remains easy for others to use too.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor turf field for an informal game.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists a turf soccer field behind Dutch Quad and says anyone can access its outdoor courts and fields.
cards.access_notes: The university says students, staff, and Capital Region community members can access outdoor courts and fields; community parking is available.

cards.title: Meet up on the grass practice field
cards.subtitle: Behind Dutch Quad, Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Use the open area for a simple frisbee toss, catch, or conversation break; leave it clear and clean when you finish.
cards.short_summary: A named campus field for unstructured outdoor time.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists a grass practice field behind Dutch Quad and says anyone can access its outdoor courts and fields.
cards.access_notes: The university says students, staff, and Capital Region community members can access outdoor courts and fields; community parking is available.

cards.title: Play at the sand volleyball court
cards.subtitle: In front of Dutch Quad, Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Gather enough people for a relaxed volley, set a friendly rotation, and bring water for warm-weather play.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus court for a no-cost game.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists a sand volleyball court in front of Dutch Quad and says anyone can access its outdoor courts and fields.
cards.access_notes: The university says students, staff, and Capital Region community members can access outdoor courts and fields; community parking is available.
